questions.prompt: What is the primary difference between a charm event hook and a charm action?
options: Actions are triggered on-demand by human operators or automation, while hooks are triggered by lifecycle/topology events
Actions run with root privileges while hooks do not
Actions are written in Go while hooks are written in Python
Actions only execute during charm compilation
questions.answer: Actions are triggered on-demand by human operators or automation, while hooks are triggered by lifecycle/topology events
questions.explanation: Event hooks respond automatically to state changes, whereas actions provide an explicit interface for day-2 operational commands.

questions.prompt: Which command executes a charm action named 'snapshot' on unit 'vault/0' in Juju 3.x?
questions.explanation: In Juju 3.x+, 'juju run' is the standard command to trigger charm actions on units or applications.

questions.prompt: How do you run an ad-hoc bash command 'cat /etc/os-release' directly on all units of application 'worker'?
questions.explanation: 'juju exec' allows executing arbitrary shell commands across targeted applications, units, or machines.

questions.prompt: Why is the Juju Secrets engine preferred over standard charm configuration for passwords and private keys?
options: Secrets are encrypted at rest, access is strictly granted per-application, and values are not leaked into plain text status or logs
Secrets can only be read once and are immediately deleted
Secrets store values directly in DNS records
questions.answer: Secrets are encrypted at rest, access is strictly granted per-application, and values are not leaked into plain text status or logs
questions.explanation: Juju Secrets provide secure storage, granular role-based grants, revision tracking, and automated rotation notifications.

questions.prompt: Which command creates a secret named 'oauth-key' with client secret parameter 'secret=12345'?
questions.explanation: 'juju add-secret <name> <key>=<value>' registers a new secret in the model.

questions.prompt: Which command grants an application named 'frontend' permission to read secret 'oauth-key'?
questions.explanation: 'juju grant-secret <secret> <app>' gives the charm authorization to fetch the secret values.

questions.prompt: What happens when an operator updates a secret revision with 'juju update-secret'?
options: Juju fires a 'secret-changed' event on all charms granted access, allowing them to reload configuration
All applications using the secret are automatically uninstalled
The controller immediately restarts the host machines
questions.answer: Juju fires a 'secret-changed' event on all charms granted access, allowing them to reload configuration
questions.explanation: Updating a secret creates a new revision and emits `secret-changed` hook events to authorized charms.

questions.prompt: What feature allows Juju charms in different models or controllers to integrate and share relations?
questions.explanation: Cross-Model Relations enable cross-boundary integrations through published and consumed application offers.

questions.prompt: Which command publishes the 'db' endpoint of 'postgres' as an offer named 'db-shared'?
questions.explanation: 'juju offer <app>:<endpoint> <offer-name>' creates a named offer for cross-model consumption.

questions.prompt: How do you integrate local application 'wiki' with an offer 'shared.db-shared' in a single command?
questions.explanation: 'juju integrate <local-app> <model.offer>' automatically consumes and establishes the cross-model relation.
